CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.accept_trade_in(p_id uuid, p_order_id bigint, p_estimated numeric, p_agreed numeric, p_actor text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE t trade_ins%ROWTYPE;o orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN IF p_agreed<=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Giá trị thỏa thuận phải lớn hơn 0';END IF;SELECT * INTO t FROM trade_ins WHERE id=p_id FOR UPDATE;IF NOT FOUND OR t.status NOT IN('QUOTED','INSPECTING') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Trade-in chưa sẵn sàng chấp nhận';END IF;SELECT * INTO o FROM orders WHERE id=p_order_id FOR UPDATE;IF NOT FOUND OR o.order_status IN('cancelled','returned') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Order không hợp lệ';END IF;IF o.debt_amount*1000000<p_agreed THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Trade-in credit vượt nghĩa vụ khách hàng';END IF;UPDATE orders SET trade_in_credit_vnd=trade_in_credit_vnd+p_agreed,debt_amount=debt_amount-p_agreed/1000000,trade_in_laptop_id=NULL,updated_at=timezone('utc',now()) WHERE id=o.id;UPDATE trade_ins SET status='ACCEPTED',order_id=o.id,estimated_value_vnd=p_estimated,agreed_value_vnd=p_agreed,updated_at=timezone('utc',now()) WHERE id=t.id RETURNING * INTO t;INSERT INTO activity_logs(entity_type,entity_id,action,changes,user_name) VALUES('TRADE_IN',t.id::text,'UPDATE',jsonb_build_object('event','TRADE_IN_ACCEPTED','order_id',o.id,'credit_vnd',p_agreed),p_actor);RETURN to_jsonb(t);END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.activate_user(target_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF (SELECT role FROM user_profiles WHERE id = auth.uid()) = 'ADMIN' THEN
    UPDATE user_profiles SET is_active = true WHERE id = target_user_id;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Access denied';
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.add_repair_action(p_job uuid, p_data jsonb, p_actor text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$ DECLARE a repair_actions%ROWTYPE;BEGIN IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repair_jobs WHERE id=p_job AND status NOT IN('COMPLETED','CANCELLED') FOR UPDATE) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Phiếu sửa không hoạt động';END IF;IF length(btrim(coalesce(p_data->>'description',''))) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 5000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Nội dung thao tác không hợp lệ';END IF;INSERT INTO repair_actions(repair_job_id,action_type,description,performed_by) VALUES(p_job,p_data->>'action_type',left(btrim(p_data->>'description'),5000),p_actor) RETURNING * INTO a;INSERT INTO activity_logs(entity_type,entity_id,action,changes,user_name) VALUES('REPAIR_ACTION',a.id::text,'CREATE',jsonb_build_object('repair_job_id',p_job,'action_type',a.action_type),p_actor);RETURN to_jsonb(a);END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_operations_summary()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH receivables AS (
  SELECT r.*
  FROM public.customer_receivable_summaries r
),
refund_due AS (
  SELECT r.id, sum(coalesce(i.agreed_refund_rmb, i.expected_refund_rmb, 0)) expected
  FROM public.supplier_returns r
  JOIN public.supplier_return_items i
    ON i.supplier_return_id = r.id
   AND i.status NOT IN ('CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED', 'REPLACED', 'REJECTED')
  WHERE r.status IN ('WAITING_REFUND', 'PARTIALLY_RESOLVED')
  GROUP BY r.id
),
refund_paid AS (
  SELECT supplier_return_id, sum(amount_rmb) paid
  FROM public.supplier_refunds
  GROUP BY supplier_return_id
)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
  'generated_at', timezone('utc', now()),
  'customer_receivable_vnd', (SELECT coalesce(sum(debt_amount), 0) * 1000000 FROM receivables),
  'customer_receivable_orders', (SELECT count(*) FROM receivables),
  'receivable_aging', coalesce((
    SELECT jsonb_object_agg(aging_bucket, jsonb_build_object('orders', n, 'amount_vnd', amount_vnd))
    FROM (
      SELECT aging_bucket, count(*) n, sum(debt_amount) * 1000000 amount_vnd
      FROM receivables
      GROUP BY aging_bucket
    ) x
  ), '{}'::jsonb),
  'cod', jsonb_build_object(
    'outstanding_vnd', (SELECT coalesce(sum(outstanding_vnd), 0) FROM public.cod_receivable_summaries WHERE status IN ('WAITING_SETTLEMENT', 'PARTIALLY_SETTLED', 'DISPUTED')),
    'in_transit_vnd', (SELECT coalesce(sum(expected_cod_amount_vnd), 0) FROM public.cod_receivable_summaries WHERE status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY'),
    'overdue_vnd', (SELECT coalesce(sum(outstanding_vnd), 0) FROM public.cod_receivable_summaries WHERE status IN ('WAITING_SETTLEMENT', 'PARTIALLY_SETTLED', 'DISPUTED') AND expected_settlement_at < now()),
    'disputed', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.cod_receivables WHERE status = 'DISPUTED')
  ),
  'supplier_payable_cny', (SELECT coalesce(sum(debt_rmb), 0) FROM public.purchase_batch_summaries WHERE status NOT IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'CLOSED')),
  'supplier_refund_pending_cny', (SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(d.expected - coalesce(p.paid, 0), 0)), 0) FROM refund_due d LEFT JOIN refund_paid p ON p.supplier_return_id = d.id),
  'accounts', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(b) ORDER BY currency, code) FROM public.cash_account_balances b WHERE is_active), '[]'::jsonb),
  'reconciliation_differences', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.cash_account_balances WHERE is_active AND coalesce(last_difference, 0) <> 0)
);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_management_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH available AS (
 SELECT l.id,l.serial,l.name,l.location,l.retail_price_vnd,l.available_for_sale_at,c.landed_cost_vnd,c.cost_status,
   CASE WHEN l.available_for_sale_at IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE greatest(floor(extract(epoch FROM(now()-l.available_for_sale_at))/86400),0)::integer END age_days
 FROM laptops l LEFT JOIN laptop_landed_costs c ON c.laptop_id=l.id
 WHERE l.is_active IS TRUE AND l.status='available'
), aging AS (
 SELECT bucket_key,bucket_label,sort_order,count(*)::integer units,
   coalesce(sum(landed_cost_vnd) FILTER(WHERE cost_status='COMPLETE'),0)::numeric(18,2) landed_cost_value,
   round(avg(age_days),1) average_age
 FROM available a CROSS JOIN LATERAL(VALUES(
   CASE WHEN age_days<=7 THEN '0_7' WHEN age_days<=15 THEN '8_15' WHEN age_days<=30 THEN '16_30'
        WHEN age_days<=60 THEN '31_60' WHEN age_days<=90 THEN '61_90' ELSE '90_plus' END,
   CASE WHEN age_days<=7 THEN '0–7 ngày' WHEN age_days<=15 THEN '8–15 ngày' WHEN age_days<=30 THEN '16–30 ngày'
        WHEN age_days<=60 THEN '31–60 ngày' WHEN age_days<=90 THEN '61–90 ngày' ELSE '90+ ngày' END,
   CASE WHEN age_days<=7 THEN 1 WHEN age_days<=15 THEN 2 WHEN age_days<=30 THEN 3
        WHEN age_days<=60 THEN 4 WHEN age_days<=90 THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
 )) b(bucket_key,bucket_label,sort_order) WHERE age_days IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket_key,bucket_label,sort_order
), states AS (
 SELECT status state,count(*)::integer units FROM laptops WHERE is_active IS TRUE GROUP BY status
), active_repairs AS (
 SELECT r.*,c.landed_cost_vnd,c.cost_status FROM repair_jobs r LEFT JOIN laptop_landed_costs c ON c.laptop_id=r.laptop_id
 WHERE r.status NOT IN('COMPLETED','CANCELLED')
), active_returns AS (
 SELECT r.id,r.status,ri.laptop_id,coalesce(ri.agreed_refund_rmb,ri.expected_refund_rmb,0) refundable_rmb,
   c.landed_cost_vnd,c.cost_status
 FROM supplier_returns r JOIN supplier_return_items ri ON ri.supplier_return_id=r.id
 LEFT JOIN laptop_landed_costs c ON c.laptop_id=ri.laptop_id
 WHERE r.status NOT IN('REFUNDED','REPLACED','REJECTED','CLOSED','CANCELLED')
), refunds AS (SELECT supplier_return_id,sum(amount_rmb) amount_rmb FROM supplier_refunds GROUP BY supplier_return_id)
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
 'generated_at',timezone('utc',now()),'thresholds',jsonb_build_object('warning_days',30,'critical_days',60),
 'available',jsonb_build_object('units',(SELECT count(*) FROM available),
   'cost_complete',(SELECT count(*) FROM available WHERE cost_status='COMPLETE'),
   'cost_incomplete',(SELECT count(*) FROM available WHERE cost_status='INCOMPLETE'),
   'legacy',0,'missing_aging_timestamp',(SELECT count(*) FROM available WHERE available_for_sale_at IS NULL),
   'known_inventory_cost_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum(landed_cost_vnd),0) FROM available WHERE cost_status='COMPLETE')),
 'aging',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(aging) ORDER BY sort_order) FROM aging),'[]'::jsonb),
 'state_summary',(SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(state,units),'{}'::jsonb) FROM states),
 'transit',jsonb_build_object('units',(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops WHERE status='in_transit'),
   'purchase_value_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum((purchase_price_rmb+shipping_rmb)*purchase_exchange_rate),0) FROM laptops WHERE status='in_transit'),
   'by_stage',jsonb_build_object('IN_TRANSIT',(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops WHERE status='in_transit'))),
 'qc',jsonb_build_object('waiting_qc',jsonb_build_object('units',(SELECT count(*) FROM laptops WHERE status='waiting_qc'),'oldest_age',0),
   'qc_in_progress',jsonb_build_object('units',(SELECT count(*) FROM qc_inspections WHERE status='IN_PROGRESS'),'oldest_age',0),
   'qc_failed',jsonb_build_object('units',0,'oldest_age',0),
   'known_cost_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum(c.landed_cost_vnd),0) FROM laptops l JOIN laptop_landed_costs c ON c.laptop_id=l.id WHERE l.status='waiting_qc' AND c.cost_status='COMPLETE')),
 'repairs',jsonb_build_object('active_jobs',(SELECT count(*) FROM active_repairs),
   'waiting_parts',(SELECT count(*) FROM active_repairs WHERE status='WAITING_PART'),'oldest_age',0,
   'accumulated_cost_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum(total_cost_vnd),0) FROM active_repairs),
   'known_laptop_cost_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum(landed_cost_vnd),0) FROM active_repairs WHERE cost_status='COMPLETE')),
 'supplier_returns',jsonb_build_object('pending',(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM active_returns),
   'shipped',(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM active_returns WHERE status IN('SHIPPED','SUPPLIER_RECEIVED')),
   'waiting_refund',(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM active_returns WHERE status IN('WAITING_REFUND','PARTIALLY_RESOLVED')),
   'waiting_replacement',(SELECT count(DISTINCT id) FROM active_returns WHERE status='WAITING_REPLACEMENT'),
   'known_cost_exposure_vnd',(SELECT coalesce(sum(landed_cost_vnd),0) FROM active_returns WHERE cost_status='COMPLETE'),
   'refund_pending_rmb',(SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(x.refundable-coalesce(rf.amount_rmb,0),0)),0)
      FROM(SELECT id,sum(refundable_rmb) refundable FROM active_returns GROUP BY id)x LEFT JOIN refunds rf ON rf.supplier_return_id=x.id)),
 'slow_moving',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY age_days DESC,laptop_id) FROM(
   SELECT id laptop_id,serial,name model,location,age_days,landed_cost_vnd,cost_status,
    round(coalesce(retail_price_vnd,0)*1000000,0) selling_price_vnd,
    CASE WHEN cost_status='COMPLETE' THEN round(coalesce(retail_price_vnd,0)*1000000-landed_cost_vnd,0) END gross_margin_potential_vnd
   FROM available WHERE age_days>=30 ORDER BY age_days DESC,id LIMIT 25)x),'[]'::jsonb)
)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sync_invoice_payment_snapshot(p_order_id bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE receipts jsonb; finance jsonb; ledger_total numeric; effective_paid numeric; payment_count bigint; current_order orders%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO current_order FROM orders WHERE id=p_order_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM invoices WHERE order_id=p_order_id) THEN RETURN; END IF;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY p.payment_date,p.id),'[]'),
        coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN p.payment_type='refund' THEN -p.amount ELSE p.amount END),0),
        count(*)
 INTO receipts,ledger_total,payment_count FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id=p_order_id;
 effective_paid := CASE WHEN payment_count > 0 THEN ledger_total ELSE coalesce(current_order.amount_paid,0) END;
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(f) ORDER BY f.occurred_on,f.id),'[]')
 INTO finance FROM financial_records f WHERE f.order_id=p_order_id;
 UPDATE invoices SET snapshot = jsonb_set(
   jsonb_set(
     jsonb_set(
       jsonb_set(
         jsonb_set(
           jsonb_set(
             jsonb_set(snapshot,'{payments}',receipts,true),
             '{financial_records}',finance,true),
           '{paid}',to_jsonb(effective_paid),true),
         '{order,payment_status}',to_jsonb(current_order.payment_status),true),
       '{order,amount_paid}',to_jsonb(coalesce(current_order.amount_paid,ledger_total)),true),
     '{order,trade_in_credit_vnd}',to_jsonb(coalesce(current_order.trade_in_credit_vnd,0)),true),
   '{order,debt_amount}',to_jsonb(coalesce(current_order.debt_amount,0)),true)
 WHERE order_id=p_order_id;
END $function$

views.name: cash_account_balances
views.definition:
SELECT a.id,
    a.code,
    a.name,
    a.account_type,
    a.currency,
    a.opening_balance,
    a.opening_balance_at,
    a.is_active,
    a.created_by,
    a.created_at,
    a.updated_at,
    (COALESCE(t.inflow, (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS inflow,
    (COALESCE(t.outflow, (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS outflow,
    (((a.opening_balance + COALESCE(t.inflow, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(t.outflow, (0)::numeric)))::numeric(20,2) AS recorded_balance,
    t.last_transaction_at,
    r.last_reconciled_at,
    r.last_difference
   FROM ((cash_accounts a
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.account_id,
            sum(x.amount) FILTER (WHERE (x.direction = 'IN'::text)) AS inflow,
            sum(x.amount) FILTER (WHERE (x.direction = 'OUT'::text)) AS outflow,
            max(x.occurred_at) AS last_transaction_at
           FROM (account_transactions x
             JOIN cash_accounts ca ON ((ca.id = x.account_id)))
          WHERE (x.occurred_at >= ca.opening_balance_at)
          GROUP BY x.account_id) t ON ((t.account_id = a.id)))
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT account_reconciliations.reconciled_at AS last_reconciled_at,
            account_reconciliations.difference AS last_difference
           FROM account_reconciliations
          WHERE (account_reconciliations.account_id = a.id)
          ORDER BY account_reconciliations.reconciled_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) r ON (true));

SELECT c.id,
    c.order_id,

    c.tracking_number,
    c.expected_cod_amount_vnd,

    c.expected_settlement_at,
    c.settled_at,
    c.notes,

    c.created_by,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    (COALESCE(s.settled_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS settled_vnd,
    (GREATEST((c.expected_cod_amount_vnd - COALESCE(s.settled_vnd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(20,2) AS outstanding_vnd,
    o.customer_id,
    o.sale_price,
    o.amount_paid,
    o.debt_amount
   FROM ((cod_receivables c
     JOIN orders o ON ((o.id = c.order_id)))

views.name: customer_receivable_summaries
views.definition:
SELECT o.id AS order_id,
    o.customer_id,
    c.name AS customer_name,
    c.phone AS customer_phone,
    o.sale_price,
    o.amount_paid,
    o.debt_amount,
    o.payment_due_at,
    o.created_date,
    o.sale_online AS salesperson,
    ( SELECT max(p.payment_date) AS max
           FROM payments p
          WHERE (p.order_id = o.id)) AS last_payment_date,
        CASE
            WHEN (o.payment_due_at IS NULL) THEN 'NO_DUE_DATE'::text
            WHEN (o.payment_due_at >= now()) THEN 'NOT_DUE'::text
            WHEN ((now() - o.payment_due_at) <= '7 days'::interval) THEN 'OVERDUE_1_7'::text
            WHEN ((now() - o.payment_due_at) <= '30 days'::interval) THEN 'OVERDUE_8_30'::text
            WHEN ((now() - o.payment_due_at) <= '60 days'::interval) THEN 'OVERDUE_31_60'::text
            ELSE 'OVERDUE_60_PLUS'::text
        END AS aging_bucket
   FROM (orders o
     LEFT JOIN customers c ON ((c.id = o.customer_id)))
  WHERE (o.is_active AND (o.debt_amount > (0)::numeric) AND ((o.order_status)::text <> ALL (ARRAY[('cancelled'::character varying)::text, ('returned'::character varying)::text])) AND ((o.payment_status)::text <> 'refunded'::text));

views.name: laptop_landed_costs
views.definition:
WITH component_sums AS (
         SELECT laptop_cost_components.laptop_id,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = 'TRADE_IN_ACQUISITION'::text)) AS trade_in_cost_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = 'VN_SHIPPING'::text)) AS vn_shipping_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = 'REPAIR'::text)) AS repair_cost_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = ANY (ARRAY['RAM_UPGRADE'::text, 'SSD_UPGRADE'::text]))) AS upgrade_cost_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = 'ACCESSORY'::text)) AS accessory_cost_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = ANY (ARRAY['CLEANING'::text, 'OTHER'::text, 'PAYMENT_FEE'::text]))) AS other_cost_vnd,
            sum(laptop_cost_components.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (laptop_cost_components.cost_type = 'REFUND_CREDIT'::text)) AS refund_credit_vnd
           FROM laptop_cost_components
          WHERE (laptop_cost_components.voided_at IS NULL)
          GROUP BY laptop_cost_components.laptop_id
        ), calculated AS (
         SELECT l.id,
            l.serial,
            l.name,
            l.category,
            l.import_date,
            l.warehouse_date,
            l.location,
            l.charger_status,
            l.status,
            l.price_rmb,
            l.shipping_rmb,
            l.exchange_rate,
            l.import_price_vnd,
            l.wholesale_price_vnd,
            l.retail_price_vnd,
            l.tracking_code,
            l.customer_note,
            l.battery_health,
            l.warranty_supplier,
            l.screen_status,
            l.camera_mic_status,
            l.mainboard_status,
            l.condition_note,
            l.seller,
            l.is_active,
            l.parts_history,
            l.month_key,
            l.created_at,
            l.updated_at,
            l.sku,
            l.available_for_sale_at,
            l.source_type,
            l.source_reference_id,
            l.purchase_batch_id,
            l.tracking_code_cn,
            l.purchase_price_rmb,
            l.purchase_exchange_rate,
            l.received_at,
            l.sold_at,
            l.ignored_at,
            l.ignored_by,
            l.ignore_reason,
            l.created_by,
                CASE
                    WHEN (l.source_type = 'TRADE_IN'::text) THEN COALESCE(c.trade_in_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric)
                    WHEN (l.purchase_exchange_rate IS NOT NULL) THEN round((l.purchase_price_rmb * l.purchase_exchange_rate), 2)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS purchase_cost_vnd,
                CASE
                    WHEN (l.purchase_exchange_rate IS NOT NULL) THEN round((l.shipping_rmb * l.purchase_exchange_rate), 2)
                    ELSE (0)::numeric
                END AS cn_shipping_vnd,
            c.vn_shipping_vnd,
            c.repair_cost_vnd,
            c.upgrade_cost_vnd,
            c.accessory_cost_vnd,
            c.other_cost_vnd,
            c.refund_credit_vnd,
                CASE
                    WHEN (l.source_type = 'UNKNOWN'::text) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
                    WHEN ((l.source_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPLIER_PURCHASE'::text, 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT'::text])) AND ((l.purchase_batch_id IS NULL) OR (l.purchase_exchange_rate IS NULL))) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
                    WHEN ((l.source_type = 'TRADE_IN'::text) AND (COALESCE(c.trade_in_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric) <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
                    WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                       FROM repair_jobs r
                      WHERE ((r.laptop_id = l.id) AND (r.status <> ALL (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text]))))) THEN 'INCOMPLETE'::text
                    ELSE 'COMPLETE'::text
                END AS cost_status
           FROM (laptops l
             LEFT JOIN component_sums c ON ((c.laptop_id = l.id)))
        )
 SELECT id AS laptop_id,
    (COALESCE(purchase_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS purchase_cost_vnd,
    (COALESCE(cn_shipping_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS cn_shipping_vnd,
    (COALESCE(vn_shipping_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS vn_shipping_vnd,
    (COALESCE(repair_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS repair_cost_vnd,
    (COALESCE(upgrade_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS upgrade_cost_vnd,
    (COALESCE(accessory_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS accessory_cost_vnd,
    (COALESCE(other_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS other_cost_vnd,
    (COALESCE(refund_credit_vnd, (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS refund_credit_vnd,
    (GREATEST((((((((COALESCE(purchase_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric) + COALESCE(cn_shipping_vnd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(vn_shipping_vnd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(repair_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(upgrade_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(accessory_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric)) + COALESCE(other_cost_vnd, (0)::numeric)) - COALESCE(refund_credit_vnd, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(18,2) AS landed_cost_vnd,
    cost_status,
    array_remove(ARRAY[
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'UNKNOWN'::text) THEN 'UNKNOWN_SOURCE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPLIER_PURCHASE'::text, 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT'::text])) AND (purchase_batch_id IS NULL)) THEN 'MISSING_PURCHASE_BATCH'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['SUPPLIER_PURCHASE'::text, 'SUPPLIER_REPLACEMENT'::text])) AND (purchase_exchange_rate IS NULL)) THEN 'MISSING_EXCHANGE_RATE'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN ((source_type = 'TRADE_IN'::text) AND (purchase_cost_vnd <= (0)::numeric)) THEN 'MISSING_TRADE_IN_ACQUISITION'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
               FROM repair_jobs r
              WHERE ((r.laptop_id = calculated.id) AND (r.status <> ALL (ARRAY['COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text]))))) THEN 'ACTIVE_REPAIR_COST_PENDING'::text
            ELSE NULL::text
        END], NULL::text) AS reasons
   FROM calculated;

views.name: order_sales_operations_summary
views.definition:
SELECT o.id AS order_id,
    (o.sale_price * (1000000)::numeric) AS sale_revenue_vnd,
    o.trade_in_credit_vnd,
    (o.debt_amount * (1000000)::numeric) AS customer_outstanding_vnd,
    o.gross_profit_snapshot_vnd,
    o.net_contribution_snapshot_vnd,
    COALESCE(sum(c.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (c.status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::text, 'PAID'::text]))), (0)::numeric) AS commission_cost_vnd,
    (o.net_contribution_snapshot_vnd - COALESCE(sum(c.amount_vnd) FILTER (WHERE (c.status = ANY (ARRAY['APPROVED'::text, 'PAID'::text]))), (0)::numeric)) AS net_contribution_after_commission_vnd
   FROM (orders o
     LEFT JOIN commissions c ON ((c.order_id = o.id)))
  GROUP BY o.id;

views.name: purchase_batch_summaries
views.definition:
SELECT b.id,
    b.batch_code,
    b.supplier_id,
    b.purchase_date,
    b.notes,
    b.created_by,
    b.created_at,
    b.updated_at,
    b.idempotency_key,
    s.code AS supplier_code,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    COALESCE(x.laptop_count, (0)::bigint) AS item_count,
    COALESCE(x.received_count, (0)::bigint) AS received_count,
    COALESCE(x.pending_count, (0)::bigint) AS pending_count,
    COALESCE(x.ignored_count, (0)::bigint) AS ignored_count,
    (COALESCE(x.purchase_total_rmb, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS subtotal_rmb,
    (COALESCE(x.purchase_total_rmb, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS purchase_total_rmb,
    (COALESCE(x.shipping_total_rmb, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS shipping_total_rmb,
    (COALESCE(x.purchase_total_rmb, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS total_rmb,
    (COALESCE(p.paid_rmb, (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS paid_rmb,
    (GREATEST((COALESCE(x.purchase_total_rmb, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(p.paid_rmb, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric))::numeric(14,2) AS debt_rmb,
        CASE
            WHEN (COALESCE(x.pending_count, (0)::bigint) = 0) THEN 'RECEIVED'::text
            WHEN (COALESCE(x.received_count, (0)::bigint) > 0) THEN 'PARTIALLY_RECEIVED'::text
            ELSE 'IN_TRANSIT'::text
        END AS status
   FROM (((purchase_batches b
     JOIN suppliers s ON ((s.id = b.supplier_id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT laptops.purchase_batch_id,
            count(*) AS laptop_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE (laptops.received_at IS NOT NULL)) AS received_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((laptops.status)::text = 'in_transit'::text)) AS pending_count,
            count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((laptops.status)::text = 'ignored'::text)) AS ignored_count,
            sum(laptops.purchase_price_rmb) FILTER (WHERE ((laptops.status)::text <> 'ignored'::text)) AS purchase_total_rmb,
            sum(laptops.shipping_rmb) FILTER (WHERE ((laptops.status)::text <> 'ignored'::text)) AS shipping_total_rmb
           FROM laptops
          WHERE (laptops.purchase_batch_id IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY laptops.purchase_batch_id) x ON ((x.purchase_batch_id = b.id)))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT supplier_payments.purchase_batch_id,
            sum(supplier_payments.amount_rmb) AS paid_rmb
           FROM supplier_payments
          GROUP BY supplier_payments.purchase_batch_id) p ON ((p.purchase_batch_id = b.id)));

views.name: unified_inventory
views.definition:
SELECT (l.id)::text AS entity_key,
    'LAPTOP'::text AS entity_type,
    l.id AS entity_id,
    l.id AS laptop_id,
    l.name,
    l.category,
    l.serial,
    l.tracking_code_cn,
    l.status AS display_status,
    l.status AS backend_status,
    s.name AS supplier_name,
    b.batch_code,
    l.received_at,
    l.warehouse_date,
    l.available_for_sale_at,
    b.purchase_date,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.purchase_date IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            ELSE to_char((b.purchase_date)::timestamp with time zone, 'MM/YYYY'::text)
        END AS month_key,
    l.purchase_price_rmb,
    l.shipping_rmb,
    l.purchase_exchange_rate AS exchange_rate,
    l.charger_status,
    l.battery_health,
    l.warranty_supplier,
        CASE
            WHEN (l.purchase_exchange_rate IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(((l.purchase_price_rmb + l.shipping_rmb) * l.purchase_exchange_rate), 2)
        END AS landed_cost_vnd,
    (l.source_type = 'UNKNOWN'::text) AS source_unresolved,
    l.condition_note AS notes
   FROM ((laptops l
     LEFT JOIN purchase_batches b ON ((b.id = l.purchase_batch_id)))
     LEFT JOIN suppliers s ON ((s.id = b.supplier_id)));
